pictures.name: MC1-Camp-At-Dawn
pictures.prompt: A desert encampment at dawn long ago, after a long, hard journey: low woven tents, cold embers, scattered bundles and water skins on the sand, the light just rising pale gold over the dunes. Weary and quiet. No people or human figures of any kind. Contemplative sacred oil painting, lifelike, rich textiles and textures, deep blue shadows, warm gold lamplight, slow and still. One tall 9:16 vertical picture, main subject in the middle. No text, no letters, no logos.
